test_title: PYST 164: SSC GD Constable - Reasoning (Held On - 09 Feb, 2023 Shift 1)
subject: reasoning
question:
'A + B' means 'A is the sister of B'.

'A - B' means 'A is the husband of B'.

'A × B' means 'A is the father of B'.

'A ÷ B' means 'A is the daughter of B'.

If R + T ÷ P - M, then how is P related to R?
solution:
Family Chart:

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/2a776c0a19b6706031165c847bcb98978a1e150482bd1260c12a74559ea55407.png] 

Decoding the Symbols:

 
 

 Symbol
 +
 -
 ×
 ÷
 
 

 Meaning
 Sister
 Husband
 Father
 Daughter
 
 

 

Given: R + T ÷ P - M

It means: R is the Sister of T, T is the daughter of P, P is the Husband of M.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/bc56de1e0576bd7e75495d3d43f9b6e318be7f9682530e57ab7aad51525c91e0.png] 

Here, P is the 'Father' of R.

Hence, the correct answer is "Option 2".
